name: Firio Osakabe
source: Firio is a member of the LWC. He has a very timid and hesitant personality, and is always being made fun of by the other members. However, when he has a gun in his hand or behind the steering wheel in a car, his personality completely changes. He has a love for machines.
translation: Firio is a member of the LWC. He has a very timid and hesitant personality, and is always being made fun of by the other members. However, when he has a gun in his hand or behind the steering wheel in a car, his personality completely changes. He has a love for machines.
